faq.q: How is a titanium submarine engine mount stud manufactured?

faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium submarine engine mount stud components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.
